answer: A community can resist sybils by bonding each identity to a scarce, slow-moving credential stake, like meltwater locked in a glacier, so that new members must acquire reputation through verifiable work rather than instant registration. Peer attestations then flow through a curated lagoon of vetted sponsors, while the ledger's basalt-hard base layer records every stake. Correlated defectors incur an exponential capital forfeiture bounded by O(Delta * S).
